output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Only 7.4.0 can have the flag, and 7.4.0 users crashed at about 2% from 2 Sep, before the flag ramp began. 7.3.2 users stayed near 0.7%. The leading 7.4.0 crash is a native crash in the upgraded image library (Pixelda 3.1, HEIF decoding). It is absent from 7.3.2, and none of the crash stacks contain canvas code. The crash-reporting SDK is not inflating the numbers: the app store's own OS-level counts agree. Device mix, usage intensity and the 9 Sep backend deploy do not explain it. Within 7.4.0, the flag-on group crashes 0.12 points more than the random flag-off holdout. That difference is within noise, so a small flag effect is not ruled out. Do not turn the flag off, close the incident and ship 7.4.0 to 100%. That would send the real crash source to every user. Hold 7.4.0 at 25% and fix the Pixelda crash first. Keep the flag holdout running, and widen it if you want an answer sooner. Don't roll back the SDK. I'm fairly sure of the main finding, less so on whether the flag has a small effect.
